reason: The host runtime (Claude Code Agent tool) launches child agents with isolation: "worktree", one native linked git worktree per worker under .claude/worktrees/, which .gitignore already ignores (.claude/). The same machine ran worktree-parallel lanes for runs 2026-10-19.NaruServe.naruserve-v1 and 2026-10-28.naru.express5-v010. No --serial option or serial wording in the request.
build_note: Lane worktrees build with -PtinyHttpdFromMaven=true because settings.gradle includeBuild resolves the sibling TinyHttpd checkout relative to the root checkout.
